title: Chapter 254 Arrival At The 66Th City
content:
Chapter 254 Arrival At The 66Th City

Wu Qing did not pay attention to the two sub-battlefields among the three battlefields of the Naga tribe. The command of the Zerg destroyers on the sub-battlefields was all in charge of the Insect Queen.

Wu Qing looked at the results of the battle. There was no suspense. On the two secondary battlefields, two thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers led nearly 100,000 Zerg Destroyers of various stars. They defeated the Skeleton Army as soon as the battle started. .

The strength of the skeleton army on the two secondary battlefields is less than 3 million, and the average strength of the skeleton soldiers is even weaker. The Zerg destroyers have the precise command of the insect queen. They cooperate with the Naga army to fight on the two secondary battlefields. It was even smoother than the main battlefield.

The senior leaders of the Naga clan soon received the news of complete victory in all three battlefields. With their determination, they were overjoyed.

Most of the senior members of the Naga clan are female Nagas.

"Haha! Three big wins! Now the Skeleton Tribe will be exhausted for a long time!"

"As long as the Skeleton Clan doesn't lose face and ask for help from other big clans in the formation god camp, our clan will have an easier time in the future! We can develop well for a while!"

"Speaking of other major tribes, our ally, the Zerg tribe, should be a major tribe that has been hiding from the world. I didn't expect that they could come back to the world!"

"With the strength of the Zerg tribe, it is only a matter of time to restore the status of the great clan. I heard that the goblin tribe has helped them enter the public battlefield in the southern theater, where they have become famous in one battle. They participated in the battle with 500,000 troops and wiped out a five-member army. A million-sized army of the outer human race!”

"This time, my clan has taken advantage of them. I will give them more compensation in other aspects in the future, and continue to deepen the relationship between the two parties before they regain their status as a powerful clan!"

"Nagaya's performance has always been excellent, and with her success in introducing the Zerg this time, her assessment period is almost over!"

"I think it's okay! She has a good relationship with the Zerg. From now on, she will be responsible for all matters related to the Zerg. Everyone should give her more support!"

"I agree!"

"..."

The battle between the Naga clan and the Skeleton clan had just ended, and the senior leaders of the Naga clan were chatting and made a series of important decisions.

The character of the Naga tribe determines that there is not much intrigue between them. Even among the highest-ranking Naga tribe members, the atmosphere of discussions is very harmonious.

With the unremitting efforts of Wu Qing and the Zerg, Nagaya's status in the Naga clan is finally about to take a big step forward.

To be honest, I have been using Yeguo Reading to catch up on books recently. I can switch sources and read aloud with a variety of sounds. It can be used on both Android and Apple.

On the main battlefield of the Naga clan, the Naga clan army did not pursue the victory and take the opportunity to regain the territory. Instead, they began to clean the battlefield and prepare to withdraw their troops and return to the city.

"On the 3rd, we are going back to the city!"

"This time our clan won so easily, thanks to you!"

"After we go back, my clan will definitely be grateful!"

Nagaya was in a happy mood.

The victory in this battle would be a great benefit to the Naga clan and to her personally.

"No more fighting? It's still early now, it's okay to have another fight!"

Wu Qing asked Nagaya through Host No. 3.

"That's almost enough. The Skeleton Tribe has been severely damaged after this battle!"

"If we really continue to fight and beat them hard, they can choose to give up this territory and hand it over to other big clans in the Evil God camp!"

"This is very detrimental to both of our tribes, so even if we win a big victory, we can't force it too much!"

"Having a weak enemy is very beneficial to our clan!"

"If you really want to continue fighting, our clan can devote its troops to other battlefields!"

"..."

Nagaya explained to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing understood immediately. Through this battle, the Naga clan took away the fate of the Skeleton clan. It would be difficult for the Skeleton clan to stand up again in the future.

The Naga tribe can use part of their strength to continue to confront the Skeleton tribe and protect their original interests, while the excess strength can be invested elsewhere to compete for more interests.

Of course, if the Skeleton Tribe does not want to take advantage of the Naga Tribe and asks for foreign aid from the Evil God camp, the Naga Tribe can also request foreign aid from the local camp.

If the two major camps invest more power here, the Naga clan will not suffer any loss. As long as the entire clan's power is invested here, they can obtain greater benefits.

From the perspective of the camp war, the Evil God camp has an absolute advantage overall. Only a few races from the local camp can take local advantages in the camp war. Now the Naga tribe has successfully done so.

The flow of luck in this world is so simple. The Naga tribe achieved this achievement in the camp war and instantly gained a lot of luck.

These fortunes were not simply plundered from the skeleton clan, but from the entire evil god camp.

This is not the same as the system plundering the soldiers of the enemy army bit by bit, but it is done at once and plunders a massive amount of luck.

Wu Qing's system is to use the enemy's members to bleed bit by bit. In this world's confrontation, with one strike, you will bleed a lot of blood.

On the three main and secondary battlefields of the Naga tribe, the Zerg destroyers all returned to the safe city under the arrangement of the Naga tribe.

The rest of the matter has nothing to do with the Zerg. The Zerg just needs to wait quietly for the thank you from Nagaya.

Wu Qing said to Nagaya that the Zerg didn't want anything else but the Luck Pearl.

Nagaya expressed her understanding. She saw with her own eyes that the Zerg Destroyer absorbed the luck from the luck beads and directly upgraded from one star to five stars.

Wu Qing reminded Naga by the way that the more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers hired by the Naga tribe cost a lot of money. Don't keep them in the city without using them all the time. You should use more to fight. It doesn't matter if you lose some. .

There are more than half a million Zerg Destroyers, including 9,000 five-star Zerg Destroyers. Wu Qing feels that such a powerful force of the Zerg Zerg is trapped in the Naga tribe, it is very wasteful.

However, these Zerg destroyers used the resources of the Naga clan and earned Wu Qing a lot of resources. Even if they were wasted, they could only sit idle and listen to the arrangements of the Naga clan.

Therefore, Wu Qing wants to express his attitude to the Naga tribe, asking them not to keep the Zerg Destroyers at home like treasures, but to let them participate in more battles.

"Don't worry! Such big battles don't happen often. Small battles still have to be fought often!"

"If our clan wants to open up a new battlefield, you will also be the main output force on the battlefield!"

Nagaya assured Wu Qing.

After receiving this guarantee, Wu Qing felt relieved and possessed Host No. 3. After admiring the Naga urban customs for a while, he returned to the public battlefield in the southern war zone.

…

The Zerg fought many battles in one day. When the three battles on the Naga side were over and the Zerg destroyers withdrew into the city, the day was almost over.

The Zerg army was marching rapidly towards the 66th city. The surrounding goblins were almost completely lost under the constant attacks of the Zerg destroyers and Zerg flying dragons. Now they have completely retreated and disappeared.

It was annoying for the Zerg army to be harassed by Goblins. Later, Wu Qing sent out all 150,000 Zerg flying dragons and carried out a large-scale sweep of the surrounding Goblins.

Only the one-star and two-star Zerg flying dragons used their advantages of air flight and speed to quickly clear out the large group of goblins. Millions of goblins fell to the biological bombs of the Zerg flying dragons.

The Zerg flying dragon's biological bomb will release a large number of micro biological bombs every time it explodes, which can cause continuous secondary and tertiary damage. It is especially useful against weak units like Goblins.

After clearing out the large army of goblins, the Zerg flying dragons dispersed again, chasing a small number of goblins one by one like a flock of birds flocking to prey, clearing out scattered goblins over a large area.

When the Zerg flying dragons fight against enemies like Goblins, it's like playing a game, as a warm-up before a big battle, and consumes very little.

With the presence of the Zerg flying dragons in the sky like natural enemies, those pesky goblins finally disappeared.

The journey went smoothly, and the Zerg army marched at full speed. When the sun was still high in the western sky, Wu Qing saw the tall walls of the 66th City under the towering mountains.

Continuing to march forward for a while, they entered the lord's protection range in the 66th city.

The Zerg army stopped advancing and began to rest on the spot. Even the Zerg dragons and other flying units flying in the sky fell to the ground to rest.

After a day of high-intensity marching, and a major battle in the middle, the Zerg army had suffered a lot and needed to recover.

The elite cavalry of the Ox tribe that followed the Zerg army marched with all their strength, and now they have basically lost their ability to fight.

"Compared with the Zerg, the gap between our clan is still a bit big. We didn't participate in the war, and we can't stand it now. The Zerg army will continue to attack the city later!"

Niu Zhong sighed to the cronies around him.

"The Zerg race must be a hidden clan that has entered the world. The strength they have shown is stronger than that of ordinary clans. It is normal for our clan to be unable to compare!"

Niu Zhong's cronies comforted him.

"Let's make arrangements and let everyone have a good rest!"

"Even if we don't need to participate in the war, we still have to stand in high spirits and watch the Zerg army take back this city that once belonged to our tribe!"

Niu Zhong stared at the 66th city in the distance that once belonged to the Niu clan, and ordered in a deep voice.

The city in the distance buried a large number of elites of the Niu tribe.

"yes!"

Niu Zhong's cronies knew that Niu Zhong was in a bad mood, so they left without saying anything more.

Except for the Zerg hosts, all other units of the Zerg army landed to rest and recover, and some five-star Zerg hosts began to go out to scout the enemy.

Next, the Zerg will attack the fortified city. According to Wu Qing's understanding, the Tianwai human army likes to rely on the fortified city for defense.

The tall walls of City 66 could be seen from a distance. Wu Qing knew that the human army from outside the world would not foolishly come out to fight with the Zerg army like the demon army.

What is most important in attacking a fortified city? Of course firepower is the most important!

Wu Qing selected more than 3,000 two-star Zerg Destroyers and spent resources to upgrade them to five-star.

The number of five-star Zerg Destroyers in the Zerg army suddenly increased to five thousand.

More than three thousand newly upgraded five-star Zerg Destroyers are still in the best combat condition and do not need to continue to recover.
